WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category, d.fiscal_period
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
)
SELECT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' WHEN store_id=999 THEN '999' ELSE 'store' END AS grp,
  count(*) AS line_rows,
  count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS distinct_lines,
  count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_sl_ids,
  count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
  sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 OR net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos,
  min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), sum(net_amount)
FROM l GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

WITH base AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.sale_date,
        s.store_id, p.category, o.web_order_id, o.status,
        CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
        CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
),
tagged AS (
 SELECT *, (store_id=900 OR web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_web,
   CASE WHEN store_id=900 OR web_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN dispatch_date ELSE sale_date END AS eff_date
 FROM base WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND NOT staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT t.is_web, (store_id=900) AS st900, (web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS in_web_tbl,
  count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(net_amount) AS net,
  round(sum(net_amount)/count(DISTINCT receipt_id),4) AS atv,
  min(status), max(status)
FROM tagged t JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=t.eff_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
GROUP BY ROLLUP(1,2,3) ORDER BY 1,2,3;

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category, d.fiscal_week
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
)
SELECT CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN 'store' WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'other'||store_id END AS grp,
  category='ZZ Test' AS test, staff_purchase_flag,
  COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) AS d_rl,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(net_amount) AS net, MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date)
FROM l GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH w AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status,
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_d,
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS disp_d
  FROM fact_web_order o
),
wl AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, MAX(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_test,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_staff, MIN(f.sale_date) AS sale_d
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'orders_total_rows_vs_distinct' AS k, COUNT(*)::VARCHAR AS a, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id)::VARCHAR AS b, '' AS c FROM w
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status_order_in_range', w.status, COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, (COUNT(wl.receipt_id))::VARCHAR FROM w LEFT JOIN wl ON wl.receipt_id=w.web_order_id
  WHERE w.order_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY w.status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status_disp_in_range', w.status, COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, SUM(wl.net)::VARCHAR FROM w JOIN wl ON wl.receipt_id=w.web_order_id
  WHERE w.disp_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND wl.has_test=0 GROUP BY w.status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status_saledate_in_range_lines', w.status, COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, SUM(wl.net)::VARCHAR FROM w JOIN wl ON wl.receipt_id=w.web_order_id
  WHERE wl.sale_d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND wl.has_test=0 GROUP BY w.status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_without_order', COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, '', '' FROM wl LEFT JOIN w ON w.web_order_id=wl.receipt_id WHERE w.web_order_id IS NULL

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_lines AS (
    -- Physical-store lines, dated by Helsinki sale_date; staff purchases, store 999 and test articles out
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_lines AS (
    -- Web order lines (store 900), dated by Helsinki dispatch date; cancelled/processing orders have no lines
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id = 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
all_lines AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_lines UNION ALL SELECT * FROM web_lines
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id),2) FROM store_lines) AS atv_stores_only,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id),2) FROM web_lines) AS atv_web_only
FROM all_lines

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id<900) AS ctrl_net,
       (SELECT SUM(receipts) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id<900) AS ctrl_receipts,
       SUM(net_amount) AS mine_net, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS mine_receipts
FROM lines
